messages:
Maria: Quick sync — final preflight for the Cloud Marketplace listing tomorrow. Need signoff on press embargo, blog draft, landing page QA, hardware partner logos, and SI integration checklist. Legal is looped. @Sophie can you confirm timeline? :eyes:

Sophie: On it. Blog draft v3 in Drive: https://drive.redwood/release/blog-draft-v3. TL;DR and edits in the doc. Need approvals by EOD to hit our publish window.

Ajay: From product: feature matrix and SKU mapping attached in the product ticket. Finance needs the SKU list before we can finish the listing form. Jason, can SI docs link be validated for the marketplace link field?

Jason: SI docs are at https://git.redwood/si/marketplace-integration. One blocker: Acme SI still pending SSO cert. Elaine, can ops reserve a staging slot for integration smoke tomorrow 09:30 PT?

Elaine: Staging slot booked 09:30 PT (staging-cluster-2). Bring test creds and service account. Also we need the exact docker image tag to push to the marketplace repo. @Maria what's the tag?

Maria: Tag = rwd-marketplace-v1.2.3. Press embargo lift set for 2024-06-18 16:00 UTC (legal confirmed). Press kit and embargo note in drive. Hardware partners provided logos but need 300x300 PNGs — Ajay, did you get resized assets?

Ajay: Titan Hardware sent SVG & hi-res PNG. Creative will resize to 300x300 png and produce alt text. Titan also requests a partner link back; confirm partner page URL to include.

Sophie: Landing page hero copy draft: "Redwood Inference now available on CloudMarket — deploy high-performance LLM inference with predictable latency and enterprise controls." Do we include a dedicated customer quote? We have one from Infralabs — is that cleared to publish?

Maria: Infralabs quote cleared by CS. Use shortened quote. Creative to produce screenshot set (console + latency chart + integration step). Also need final alt text for logos for a11y.

Jason: Small blocker on billing integration test in marketplace sandbox — missing X-Cost-Center header causes 400. Repro steps:
```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.marketplace/charge -H "X-Cost-Center:"
# returns 400 Bad Request
```
Can SI integrations add that header? If not, we need a server-side default.

Ajay: Prefer explicit header from SI teams; I'll ping Acme and Orbit SIs to add it. If they can't, we can add a fallback mapping but will need an update to the API contract.

Sophie: For press assets we also need high-res screenshots by 2pm PT. @Jason can you grab 3 console screenshots and drop them in the drive by 14:00 PT?

Jason: Yep — will capture and upload by 14:00 PT.

Elaine: Ops checklist is green except TLS cert for the marketplace redirect hasn't been uploaded. @kevin-infra assigned — need cert in staging before 17:00 PT.

kevin-infra: Uploaded the TLS cert to staging just now and verified with curl: TLS handshake OK. Pushed cert: rwd-marketplace-staging-cert.pem.

partners-bot: Reminder: runway cutoff for marketplace listing pipeline is 2024-06-17 23:59 PT — after that we can’t guarantee slots for launch. :calendar:

Sophie: Approvals required by 17:00 PT today: Marketing, Legal, Product. If anyone has objections speak now.

Ajay: Product signoff — OK.

Maria: Legal signoff — OK.

Sophie: Marketing signoff — OK. Moving the blog + landing page into the publish runbook.

Maria: I'll assemble the final launch runbook (including staging checklist, contact list, and rollback steps) and post it in #partnerships after this thread. Thanks all. :rocket:
